prompt:
Edit the referenced four-character animation asset to create ONE NEW FRAME of the SAME walking cycle, with smooth anatomically plausible change in limb pose.
Keep exact same four students, hairstyles, navy/coral/green/mustard clothing, body proportions, scale, quadrant centers and direct vertical orthographic camera. Tops of heads at the same pixel locations; no camera or torso rotation. They all walk toward TOP. Keep clothing texture and soft diffuse light unchanged. Upper-left navy/khaki; upper-right coral/blue jeans/ponytail; lower-left green/charcoal; lower-right mustard/navy.
CRITICAL: change the feet and arms to the requested gait phase rather than copying the original pose. The LEFT side of each person's body is the left of the image because they face image top. Arms swing OPPOSITE their corresponding leg. Limbs foreshorten naturally under the strict overhead camera. No exaggerated lunge or front view.
Output square image, four full silhouettes separated in equal quadrants; centers at 25%/75% in x and y. Uniform bright magenta #FF00FF background for later chroma key. No checkerboard, scenery, floor, shadows, labels or new props. This is a single animation frame, not a montage of different times.
FRAME 19 / 24, phase 270 degrees. This is a compact passing pose, between right footfall and next left footfall. RIGHT leg supports the body, LEFT knee bends as the LEFT foot swings forward beside the right ankle. BOTH shoes close below the torso, not one far in front and one far behind. Both elbows relaxed alongside body; arms nearly neutral with RIGHT hand beginning to advance. Compared with reference 1, greatly REDUCE front-to-back leg spread; the silhouette is more compact. Keep heads centered, same shoulder size.
